This rider amends the certificate named above to:
• Add a waiting period for Class II and Class III services for non-pediatric
members
This rider is deemed in effect when you or your remitting agent is notified.

This rider changes the coverage in your certificate. Your rider and certificate
are meant to be read together. It is important to review these changes to
understand how your coverage has changed.
Section 1: Information About Your Contract
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider adds waiting periods for Class II and Class III services for non-
pediatric members.
Replace the first paragraph of the
When Your Benefits Begin subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
When Your Benefits Begin
Most benefits are available on the effective date of your contract. However,
a waiting period applies to Class II and Class III services as follows:
• A 6-month waiting period applies to Class II services except for
dental sealants and emergency palliative treatments.
• A 12-month waiting period applies to Class III services.
These waiting periods apply only to non-pediatric members.
Benefits become effective on the day after the last day of the
waiting period.
For a 12-month waiting period, if your contract becomes
effective on July 1, the last date of the waiting period will be
June 30 of the following year. Benefits become available on
July 1 of that year.
Class I benefits are not affected by this rider.
2 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

GENERAL
Until further notice, all the provisions in your certificate and in your related
riders are unchanged and in full force and effect, except as stated in this rider.
